meaning: (Qal) to be pleasant, be beautiful, be sweet, be delightful, be lovely

renderings.kjv: Whom dost thou pass in beauty

elsewhere.note: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
